_meta.name: sem-ordinal-wlsmv
_meta.description: The three-factor CFA of brand_survey.pulse (quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3, value =~ v1 + v2 + v3, service =~ s1 + s2 + s3) with its nine 1-5 ratings read two ways. ml is lavaan's maximum likelihood fit with a mean structure: the ratings as continuous, with a log-likelihood, aic and bic. wlsmv sets estimator wlsmv with every rating in ordered: lavaan's two-step fit to the thresholds and polychoric correlations, one x | tk row per threshold (four per 1-5 rating), robust standard errors, the unscaled chi2 with a null p and no log-likelihood, and the scaled-shifted test (chi2_scaled, chi2_scaled_p_value, scaling_factor, shift_parameter) with cfi_scaled, tli_scaled and rmsea_scaled; judge its fit by the scaled figures. waves is the same ordinal model as one joint fit across the two survey waves with thresholds, loadings and intercepts held equal (group_equal), which frees wave2's latent means: the [wave2] value ~1 and [wave2] service ~1 rows recover the fixture's planted shift (value down, service up, quality unchanged), on the scale of each marker's underlying response. Compare the ml and wlsmv std_estimate loadings to see how much the continuous reading costs. The ordinal estimator needs every row (Gamma), so the request runs buffered.
